Standardised card for holding leaflet maps, with a Shiny module

Source: R/map_card_module.R
map_card_module.Rd

Use map_cardUI in app UI, using a unique id value. Use map_cardServer in the shiny server function, with a matching id value. Create the map to be displayed as a reactive outside of this function.

map_cardUI(
  id,
  header = NULL,
  use_opacity = TRUE,
  leaflet_height = 400,
  full_screen = FALSE
)

map_cardServer(id, map)

Arguments

id

Module namespace ID. Must match id used in map_cardUI.

header

Optional header content. Use bslib::card_header(..) to add.

use_opacity

Logical - add a raster opacity slider in the card footer?

leaflet_height

Height of the leaflet UI. Sent to the height argument of the leafletOutput.

full_screen

Logical, sent to the full_screen argument of the card.

map

Reactive leaflet map. Construct the base map layers to be included in the card as a reactive outside of this module.

Value

For map_cardUI: A bslib::card UI object

For map_cardServer: List with this module's session object and map opacity and basemap controls.

Details

Card body is filled with a map with no padding. Designed mainly for 'side-by-side' maps. Card footer contains controls for basemap (as side-by-side maps can't handle it with native leaflet basemap controls) and, optionally, raster opacity.

map_cardServer creates output$map, namespaced by the id. To update the map via leafletProxy, use the session argument, i.e. leafletProxy("map", session = ..).
